Overview

Jersey City is a city in NJ with a population of 292,449. NYC’s sixth borough with PATH trains, waterfront views, and slightly cheaper than Manhattan. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.7.
